sources.trees: published vegetation of grounds/tortuna/ground-v2-29bbfb05ea74fb0e0ab9f6347d4df4b80a2b12e44316f40fae8c9270cd92f44a.json: 2383 crowns + 36217 stand trees, planted by the runtime planner
sources.check: Lantmäteriet Ortofoto_0.16 (orto-n2-2026, 2026-05-02) through the Min karta WMS; the mown score of trace-fairways.mjs, never an input to the fit

why: Every Lantmäteriet capture of this course is a spring one, as is the one Esri's live mosaic serves; in May the fairway cannot be told from the mown rough in colour or NIR, so the 2026 rule trace clipped the mown estate to a 24 m design half-width. The club plans draw the fairway itself.
